officialSources.use: Verify the upstream template revision and actual supported frontend/Tauri versions during P00.

officialSources.title: Tauri capabilities
officialSources.use: Capabilities and custom native command authorization must be reviewed together; frontend permission lists are not a substitute for native validation.

officialSources.title: Git push
officialSources.use: Mirror, atomic and exact expected-value lease semantics inform the safe explicit-ref plan.

officialSources.title: GitHub repository duplication
officialSources.use: Git LFS payload transfer is separate from a Git mirror.

officialSources.title: GitHub repositories REST API
officialSources.use: Authenticated repository enumeration, pagination and permissions must be matched to the chosen credential type.

officialSources.title: GitHub App user authentication
officialSources.use: GitHub App user-access flow is not equivalent to a PAT and requires separately verified registration/permissions.

officialSources.title: Rust API guidelines
officialSources.use: Use idiomatic typed public interfaces, useful errors and documented invariants.

officialSources.title: Tokio process
officialSources.use: Child lifecycle, cancellation and waiting/reaping require deliberate implementation.

officialSources.title: React effect guidance
officialSources.use: Avoid redundant derived state/effects; keep actual synchronization effects bounded and cleaned up.

officialSources.title: Playwright visual comparisons
officialSources.use: Pinned rendering and managed expected screenshots are required for meaningful visual regressions.

officialSources.title: Lucide React
officialSources.use: Use actual supported icon exports; do not fabricate component names or recreate brand artwork.

officialSources.title: GitLab projects API
officialSources.use: Project creation, namespace, visibility and lookup behavior require verified API permissions.

officialSources.title: SQLite WAL
officialSources.use: Read concurrency does not remove writer/lifecycle/backup constraints; validate chosen journal setup.

officialSources.title: Git bundle
officialSources.use: Bundle creation and verification support isolated Git recovery; coverage is explicitly selected.

officialSources.title: GitLab OAuth
officialSources.use: OAuth/PKCE/device support and instance/version prerequisites must be checked for the deferred auth extension.

officialSources.title: Tauri prerequisites
officialSources.use: Linux native dependencies and target environment must be recorded, not inferred from a web build.

officialSources.title: Tauri WebDriver testing
officialSources.use: Native application tests require platform-specific setup; they are distinct from browser mocks.

officialSources.title: Git fetch
officialSources.use: Refspec, tags, shallow/partial history and recursion behavior must be explicit in the backup engine.

officialSources.title: Rust keyring crate
officialSources.use: Inspect the exact installed backend, feature flags and APIs during P00/P03; no exact version is claimed here.
